Module com.mycompany.urbanlegends
Package controllers

Class MapController

java.lang.Object
controllers.MapController
All Implemented Interfaces:
TimeObserver, javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class MapController extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable, TimeObserver
FXML Controller class Manages the map, player view, and grid display for the game. It is responsible for rendering the tiles, updating the map, and managing user interactions with the interface. Implements Initializable interface to handle the initialization process.
Author:
Ismael Marchena, Jorge Rojas, Fabian Arguedas, Joxan Portilla, Melani Barrantes
